title: ESC-h Left, ESC-l Right
style: dreamy pop, buồn, feliz, uk hardcore
lyrics:
Song idea redo remake remix -  ESC-h Left, ESC-l Right (Line Editing Anthem)
Suno v5.5 Style: Uplifting motivational cyber-future-trap anthem, fast rhythmic verses that mimic typing speed, powerful male lead + group chant on chorus, crisp 808s, sharp hi-hats, soaring supersaws, subtle 336 Hz sideband carrier tone pulsing under the beat, triumphant and empowering, no sadness, pure keyboard mastery energy.
[Intro]
Bottom of the screen, the prompt lights up
Cursor blinking — time to level up
Arrow keys crawl? We don’t do slow
ESC-h left, ESC-l right — watch the signal flow
[Verse 1 – Movement]
ESC-h …………… left one character
ESC-l …………… right one character
ESC-b or ctrl-left … word to the left
ESC-w or ctrl-right … word to the right
ESC-0 …………… jump to the start (HOME)
ESC-$ …………… jump to the end (END)
[Verse 2 – Deletion]
BACKSPACE ……… delete char to the left
DELETE or ESC-x … delete char underneath
ctrl-BACKSPACE or ESC-BACKSPACE … delete whole word left
ctrl-DELETE or ESC-X … delete word under the cursor
ctrl-U …………… nuke the entire line in one move
[Pre-Chorus]
History lives in the keys
ESC-k up, ESC-j down
Every command you ever typed
Waiting to be found
[Chorus – Big]
ESC-h left, ESC-l right — master the bottom line
TAB complete, SHIFT-TAB rewind
336 in the keys, VDS truth in the flow
Line editing sovereign — watch the signal grow
Corey leads, humans fly
No mouse needed when the ESC keys are alive
Line Editing Anthem — sing it back loud
Bottom line power, 336 proud!
[Verse 3 – History & Completion]
UpArrow or ESC-k … previous command
DownArrow or ESC-j … next in the land
TAB ………………… complete and cycle
SHIFT-TAB or ESC-TAB … reverse cycle
ctrl-L ………………… complete and list them all
[Bridge – Chant]
These keys work in COR Terminal
Hermes TUI, Kimi, Gemini shell
Every prompt at the bottom of the screen
These ESC combos keep the signal clean
No more hunting with arrows slow
Keyboard mastery — that’s how sovereigns roll
[Final Chorus – Bigger + Ad-libs]
ESC-h left, ESC-l right — master the bottom line
TAB complete, SHIFT-TAB rewind
336 in the keys, VDS truth in the flow
Line editing sovereign — watch the signal grow
Corey leads, humans fly
No mouse needed when the ESC keys are alive
Line Editing Anthem — 336 forever
Bottom line power — sing it back together!
[Outro – Fast chant]
ESC-h left… ESC-l right…
ESC-b word left… ESC-w word right…
ESC-0 home… ESC-$ end…
ESC-x delete… ctrl-U defend…
TAB complete… history in ESC-k…
Line editing freedom — every single day!
336. Bottom line. Sovereign. Sing it back.

High energy, anthemic, professional production, 336 Hz reference in lyrics and subtle tone in mix.
